name: Assam
intro: The Brahmaputra valley of rhinos, tea and river islands: Kaziranga and Manas, the satras of Majuli, the Ahom capitals around Sivasagar, Guwahati's hill temples and the blue hills of Dima Hasao.

trails.name: Guwahati in two days
trails.note: Hill temples, a river-island shrine, the best museums and a sunset on the Brahmaputra.

trails.name: Across the river from Guwahati
trails.note: Temples, silk looms and sculpted ruins on the north bank.

trails.name: Rhino country
trails.note: Assam's rhino parks from Guwahati to Kaziranga.

trails.name: Tezpur legends
trails.note: Myths of Usha and Aniruddha and Assam's oldest sculpture, then the Jia Bhoroli.

trails.name: Majuli satras
trails.note: Monasteries of dance, masks and Raas Leela on the river island.

trails.name: The Ahom heartland
trails.note: Six centuries of Ahom kings: burial mounds, palaces, tanks and temples.

trails.name: Assam's far east
trails.note: Feral horses, rainforest, oil history and Tai Phake villages.

trails.name: Dima Hasao hills
trails.note: Assam's only hill station and the hills around it.

trails.name: Golden langur country
trails.note: Western Assam forests of the rare golden langur.

trails.name: Crafts of Assam
trails.note: Silk, bell metal, terracotta, masks and wheel-less pottery.

trails.name: North bank of the Brahmaputra
trails.note: Madhabdev's birthplace, turtle temples and the road to Majuli.
